Package hadur117.core.melee

Class TeamDuelGun

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.TeamDuelGun
public final class TeamDuelGun extends Object
TGUN-1..3, the team duelist's gun (Leigh's strategy doc of 2026-11-04): the duel's GunController (the main GF kNN, the anti-surfer views and the hybrid, picked by their virtual scores) aimed at the field gun's target. Every sighting of an enemy, the member's own scans and its teammates' alike, makes a gun wave from where the member stood to the enemy, as the duel makes one per scan; the waves break on that enemy's later sightings and teach views kept per enemy class (key), so all copies of a class and all five observers fill one record from the first round.

The field gun keeps a target until the duel gun has learned its class (MIN_BREAKS waves broken) and has a fresh wave on it (no older than MAX_WAVE_AGE ticks); the power is always the field gun's.

    • aim

      public double aim(String target, Point2D.Double me, long time, double power)
      The duel gun's angle at target from me on time for a shot of power, or NaN while it has not learned the target's class or has no fresh wave on it. The wave takes the shot's power first (GUN-5: the gun is picked from that power class's ratings), as the duel decides power before aim.
